title: Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. translated_title: 基于音频语言模型的临床精神病学语音录音中角色引导的说话人删除验证
translated_abstract: 精神病学临床研究日益依赖大规模口语数据的收集来识别声学和语言学生物标志物。然而，不断演变的知情同意和协议要求可能迫使研究人员从多说话人录音中删除指定的说话人，并需要在大规模数据上验证删除效果，而这一规模使得人工审查整个语料库变得不可行。我们针对精神病学中角色驱动的双人临床对话研究这一验证问题，并采用两条并行、对称的流水线进行研究：一条用于确认临床医生语音已从精神科访谈录音中删除，另一条用于确认患者语音已从相同录音中删除。每条流水线首先对其目标角色的原始音频进行删减，然后使用音频语言模型和大语言模型扫描剩余输出，以识别遗漏删除的内容。我们在来自精神病学场景的48个双人录音语料库上对该方法进行了评估……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于音频语言模型和大语言模型的双对称流水线方法，用于自动验证精神科临床双人对话录音中指定角色（临床医生或患者）的语音是否已被彻底删除，从而在大规模数据无法人工审查的情况下保证隐私删除的完整性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual, symmetric pipeline based on audio-language models and large-language models to automatically verify that role-specific clinician or patient speech has been fully removed from dyadic psychiatric interview recordings, ensuring deletion completeness at a scale infeasible for manual corpus review.
